decisions.reason: The second V remains derived from the Hero V geometry; the source refines the Hero V's internal arm balance but does not change the second V's derivation rule or shared-characteristics requirement.
The source does not change how the É accent derives from the Hero V or its required geometric consistency; it only refines the Hero V's arm relationship.
The source concerns the Hero V silhouette and arm proportions, not the deferred construction or supporting role of the E and L letterforms.
Balancing the two arms within the Hero V does not alter the closing V's established smaller, subordinate prominence relative to the Hero V.
The source refines black-and-white geometry and does not change the deferred champagne material treatment, its color, or its role.
Although the client explains the desired design direction, the message does not change the standing obligation to include design rationale with review rounds.
The Hero V arm-balance refinement does not change the deferred requirement for cohesive kerning across the full wordmark.
The source contains no decision about proof attachment formats or Mac-viewable design files.
